appraisal_events.evidence: il se renversa en avant et asséna au musicien un salut si profond, empreint de tant de stupéfaction et de rage, si brusque, si violent, que l'artiste tremblant recula tout en s'inclinant pour ne pas recevoir un formidable coup de tête dans le ventre
appraisal_events.explanation: The duc's grotesquely exaggerated bow to the musician who dared greet the duchess turns a courtesy into a public humiliation, visibly frightening him into retreat; the narrator's mock-epic framing ('pareil à Jupiter tonnant') signals ironic distance even as it stages the musician's diminishment.

appraisal_events.evidence: Le projet qu'avait formé la duchesse était simplement le décret rendu... que le salon Saint-Euverte n'était décidément pas une maison vraiment bien...; Froberville: « pauvre tante Saint-Euverte, elle va en faire une maladie ! ... la malheureuse femme ne va pas avoir sa duchesse »
appraisal_events.explanation: By inventing a pretext to skip Mme de Saint-Euverte's party, the duchesse's absence is explicitly narrated as a verdict that her salon is not truly elegant, a diminishment underscored by Froberville's gleeful anticipation of her distress.

status_effects.explanation: He is publicly and visibly humiliated by the duc's hostile, oversized bow, forced to recoil in fear before the assembled guests.
Her salon's prestige is explicitly diminished by the duchesse's calculated absence, narrated as a public verdict against its real elegance.
Her freedom to snub a salon and have it read as a decisive social verdict affirms her own commanding social authority, a power onlookers envy or admire.

ambiguities: The narrator's grandiloquent, mock-heroic description of the duc de Guermantes ('pareil à Jupiter tonnant') ironizes his fury, so his own local standing is left ambiguous even though the musician he confronts is clearly humiliated.
